title: Suresh Sallay’s treatment under PTA is deeply troubling - Namal Rajapaksa
summary: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa said that concerns raised before court by the legal counsel of Major General (Retd.) Suresh Sallay regarding his treatment in custody, was deeply troubling and asked why activists who were against the PTA maintained such a silence.

title: Suresh Salley being used as a scapegoat, says wife following CID visit
summary: Speaking to the media for the first time outside the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), Manory Salley, the wife of former Major General Suresh Salley, defended her husband, insisting that he is innocent and is being unfairly used as a ’’scapegoat.’’
